facility.name: Ivette Valdespino
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Field Trips

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: The two dogs in the home had vaccine records that expired in May 2026 and June 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Out of 5 children's records evaluated, the admission information of one child was observed to be missing emergency medical information in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Name and Birthdate: Out of 5 children's records evaluated, two children's admission information was observed to be missing birthdate information in their files.    Note: The primary caregiver was corrected at inspection time .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Name and Birthdate (26 TAC §747.605(1))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The documentation on the safety drills did not include severe weather or lock down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: The admission forms used were outdated. The admission forms do not capture the required minimum standards changes of March 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The provider received training on 03/18/2024 on CPR/AED: Adult, Child & Infant + First Aid (BLS). The documentation lacked pediatric first aid and pediatric CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There were no written feeding instructions for the infant in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The cots were not labeled with child's name or number/child assigemen map was not available. This was corrected during the inspection when the provider placed labels on the cots.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §747.4303(b))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The provider received training on 03/18/2024 on CPR/AED: Adult, Child & Infant + First Aid (BLS). The documentation lacked pediatric first aid and pediatric CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children: There was a product whose label indicated to keep out of reach of children.  It was accessible to children as it was on the ground in the outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines: There was a trampoline in the backyard with an apparatus near the tramoline which may be used to climb onto the trampoline, and the netting was unzipped.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines (26 TAC §747.4403(3))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: The admission forms used were outdated. The admission forms do not capture the required minimum standards changes of March 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The provider completed 20 of the required 30 annual hours of training for training period 07/21/23-07/21/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by the provider.  The required training topics are 1. emergency preparedness 2. communicable diseases to include immunizations 3. administering medication 4. preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The play structure's use zone was not free of obstacles that a child could run into or fall on top of and be injured. The play structures did not have the proper use zone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §747.4603)

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: The children's files enrolled in care does not have a written parent notification of liability insurance. It was not posted or in the operational policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There were no written feeding instructions for the infant in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: There was no documenation on the safety drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Animals: The operational policies did not indicate that the operation has animals (dogs) in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Animals (26 TAC §747.501(7))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: The last documentation of the dogs being vaccinated was 11/10/20.  They were due to be vaccinated by 11/10/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines: There was a trampoline in the backyard with removal step ladder attached, and the netting unzipped. This was corrected at the inspection when th provider removed the step ladder and zipped the netting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines (26 TAC §747.4403(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two children's files did not have the immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The provider completed 20 of the required 30 training hours for training period 07/21/21-07/21/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: There were 2 children's files that lacked the health statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - in Front and Rear: The swings did not have the appropriate use to and fro zone.  The swings were set close to the fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - in Front and Rear (26 TAC §747.4607(a))
